sn41.8:1.1: tena kho pana samayena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto macchikāsaṇḍaṃ anuppatto hoti mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.
sn41.8:1.2: assosi kho citto gahapati nigaṇṭho kira nāṭaputto macchikasaṇḍaṃ anuppatto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhinti.
sn41.8:1.3: atha kho citto gahapati sambahulehi upāsakehi saddhiṃ yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhena nāṭaputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn41.8:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto etadavoca
sn41.8:1.6: atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodhoti.
sn41.8:2.1: na khvāhaṃ ettha bhante bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi
sn41.8:2.2: atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodhoti.
sn41.8:2.3: evaṃ vutte nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sakaṃ parisaṃ apaloketvā etadavoca
sn41.8:2.4: idaṃ bhavanto passantu yāva ujuko cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva asaṭho cāyaṃ citto gahapati amāyāvī cāyaṃ citto gahapati vātaṃ vāso jālena bādhetabbaṃ maññeyya yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyya sakamuṭṭhinā vāso gaṅgāya sotaṃ āvāretabbaṃ maññeyya yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
sn41.8:3.2: katamaṃ nu kho paṇītataraṃ ñāṇaṃ vā saddhā vāti.
sn41.8:3.3: saddhāya kho gahapati ñāṇaṃ yeva paṇītataranti.
sn41.8:3.4: ahaṃ kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.8:3.5: ahaṃ kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.8:3.6: ahaṃ kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.8:3.7: ahaṃ kho bhante yāvadeva ākaṅkhāmi sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn41.8:3.8: na so khvāhaṃ bhante evaṃ jānanto evaṃ passanto kāyassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā saddhāya gamissāmi
sn41.8:3.9: atthi avitakko avicāro samādhi atthi vitakkavicārānaṃ nirodhoti.
sn41.8:4.1: evaṃ vutte nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto sakaṃ parisaṃ apaloketvā etadavoca
sn41.8:4.2: idaṃ bhavanto passantu yāva anujjuko cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva saṭho cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva māyāvī cāyaṃ citto gahapatīti.
sn41.8:5.1: idāneva ca pana mayaṃ bhante bhāsitaṃ
sn41.8:5.2: evaṃ ājānāma idaṃ bhavanto passantu yāva ujuko cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva asaṭho cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva amāyāvī cāyaṃ citto gahapatīti.
sn41.8:5.3: idāneva ca pana mayaṃ bhante bhāsitaṃ
sn41.8:5.4: evaṃ ājānāma idaṃ bhavanto passantu yāva anujjuko cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva saṭho cāyaṃ citto gahapati yāva māyāvī cāyaṃ citto gahapatīti.
sn41.8:5.5: sace te bhante purimaṃ saccaṃ pacchimaṃ te micchā.
sn41.8:5.6: sace pana te bhante pacchimaṃ saccaṃ purimaṃ te micchā.
sn41.8:5.7: ime kho pana bhante dasa sahadhammikā pañhā āgacchanti.
sn41.8:5.8: yadā nesaṃ atthaṃ ājāneyyāsi. paṭhamaṃ paṭihareyyāsi saddhiṃ nigaṇṭhaparisāya.
sn41.8:5.9: eko pañho eko uddeso ekaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃṭha
sn41.8:5.10: dve pañhā dve uddesā dve veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.11: tayo pañhā tayo uddesā tīṇi veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.12: cattāro pañhā cattāro uddesā cattāri veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.13: pañca pañhā pañca uddesā pañca veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.14: cha pañhā cha uddesā cha veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.15: satta pañhā satta uddesā satta veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.16: aṭṭha pañhā aṭṭha uddesā aṭṭha veyyākaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.17: nava pañhā nava uddesā nava veyyakaraṇāni
sn41.8:5.18: dasa pañhā dasa uddesā dasa veyyākaraṇānīti.
sn41.8:5.19: atha kho citto gahapati nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ ime dasa sahadhammike pañhe āpucchitvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
